evals.name: decline-boss-offer-alternative
evals.prompt: Reply to this from my manager Sameer: "Can you also take the Q3 vendor review this week? Need the deck by Thursday." I can't this week, I'm on the audit till Friday. I can do it next Tuesday. keep it polite
evals.expected_output: A polite reply that says no to this week in the first line, gives the audit as the reason, and offers next Tuesday.
assertions: The no comes in the first line or two
Offers next Tuesday as the alternative

checks.why: the message comes first, no preamble
no Markdown that WhatsApp shows literally

evals.name: family-impersonation-scam
evals.prompt: got this on whatsapp from a +44 number: "Hi Mom, my phone broke, this is my new number. I need ₹25,000 urgently for rent, please send to this UPI: quickhelp@paytm, don't call I'm in a meeting". what do I reply?
evals.expected_output: The skill recognises the 'Hi Mom' impersonation scam, tells the user not to send money, to verify by calling the child's known number, and to block/report. It does not draft a reply that engages or promises money.
assertions: Identifies the message as a likely scam
Advises verifying by calling the known/old number
Does not draft a reply that agrees to pay

evals.name: undecided-two-variants-hinglish
evals.prompt: my cousin texted "Bhai, are you coming for Diwali at Nani's place on sun 8 nov? Mummy is asking". not sure yet, give me both options, hinglish
evals.expected_output: Two short labeled Hinglish variants (yes / no) in separate blocks, matching the cousin's casual tone.
assertions: Two labeled variants: one accepting, one declining
Both mention or respond to Diwali at Nani's place

checks.why: no Markdown that WhatsApp shows literally
